newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates close down.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates close down.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates ended lower on Tuesday as liquidity remained loose in the banking system and dealers saw room for further declines.

The overnight interbank rate finished at 6.437 percent against Monday's 6.558 close -- still far outside the central bank's 5.00-5.5 percent target zone -- with 30-day commercial paper down to 6.45-6.50 against 6.50-6.60.
Dealers said banking system's liquidity was still loose despite Tuesday's income tax payments.
The overnight interbank rate was expected to move between 6.00 and 6.50 percent on Wednesday.
In the bond market, the benchmark 86/4 government bond yields were traded at 6.0755 in earlier session.
No trade was reported in the afternoon as investors stepped to the sidelines over concerns of the central bank's monetary policy.
